scope: Isolated own browser fixtures, no TV/real player/media

checks.name: Legacy v1 data is read without startup migration/write or automatic watched marks
Manual mark persists across reload, keeps favorites/history/preferences and shows both independent badges
Removing the only watched record survives reload and returns focus to the empty collection tab
Storage failure leaves persisted data, count, button state and focus unchanged with a clear error
Pagination renders at most30 cards, preserves detail return and clamps empty last page to the nearest remaining card
D-pad scrolling keeps the selected watched card above the fixed remote hint
At1000 records no mark is silently evicted and the DOM still has only one30-card page
Opening/seeking/ended/closing a player writes recent history but never marks a film watched
